title: Grants for Kindergarten Education and Provision of Educational Support for Children with Special Needs in Preschools
what_it_is: Grants for Kindergarten Education and Provision of Educational Support for Children with Special Needs in Preschools

sections.label: Preschool funding and support
sections.summary: The Government funds Anchor, Partner and MOE Kindergartens and provides broad-based sector support including professional development and productivity grants.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: To this end, the Government supports Anchor Operators, Partner Operators and Ministry of Education (MOE) Kindergartens with recurrent funding to uplift preschool quality while providing affordable options.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: We will also continue to provide broad-based support for the sector as a whole to benefit all operators and early childhood educators.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: These include funding schemes, such as the Professional Development Programmes, which all kindergarten and childcare centres can apply for in order to support educators' professional development, as well as grants to improve productivity using technology solutions, and to foster more innovative teaching practices.

sections.label: Early intervention and preschool support
sections.summary: Children under seven with developmental needs get support in preschools, with new programmes, enhanced subsidies and services moving to ECDA by end-2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Children under the age of seven with mild developmental needs can get support from the Development Support and Learning Support Programmes in some 550 preschools.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Through the new Development Support Plus programme, which will be progressively rolled out from July 2019, children with mild to moderate developmental needs who have made sufficient progress at Early Intervention Programme for Infants and Children (EIPIC) centres will be able to receive intervention support directly at the preschools they are enrolled in.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: With effect from 1 April 2019, we have made such early intervention services more affordable for Singaporean children by enhancing the subsidies and broadening the income criteria for means-tested subsidies so that more families qualify.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The workgroup, comprising people, private and public sector partners, will study the experiences of centres which serve children with moderate to severe developmental needs, to develop approaches that may be extended to more preschools.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: All early intervention services will come under ECDA by end-2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The Government will continue to improve the access to quality and affordable preschools for every child to have a good start in life.
